en: A vintage black‑and‑white street view showing a narrow cobblestone road lined with multi‑story buildings with shutters and balconies. At the end of the street stands a prominent church with a tall bell tower and dome. Pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the street. At the bottom edge, printed text identifies the scene as Trento – Via Camillo Cavour.
